Between Day and Night

Acrylic painting on canvas with a wooden base of functional art having a top of sawn live edge · 67” width × 35” height × 20” depth

Inspired by those quiet hours when a city winds down, sleeps, and wakes up again. One side captures the bright energy of the afternoon which then slowly softens into a deep, indigo twilight. But as you follow the piece around, the dark gives way to that first, crisp line of morning gold. It’s the feeling of a fresh start, right before the rest of the world wakes up. ​A warm, live-edge wood top sits above it all, like a steady horizon line.

About the artist

Different Strokes opened its doors in 2001.
